runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: back-view albedo texture source for the existing Kreegan scrap bundle 3D model.
Produce exactly ONE 1024 x 1024 PNG with a genuine transparent background, at native generation resolution.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1, guide_back.png, is the EDIT TARGET and the absolute authority for every pixel of geometry, the orthographic back camera, silhouette, scale, position, openings and shape edges.
Image 2, design_reference.png, is the approved design, colour and material authority ONLY.
Image 3, concept_crop.png, is the original concept supporting the material identities ONLY.
Paint directly over Image 1. Preserve its original alpha silhouette exactly, including the transparent opening at the left claw. Do not use the camera, pose, silhouette, framing, or lighting of images 2 or 3.

GEOMETRY LOCK:
The guide is a 1024 x 1024 square. The entire object occupies x=172..851 and y=274..749. Keep those margins and all geometry exactly. Do not enlarge or recenter it. Retain the faceted outline, the claw extending down the LEFT side with its tip near (296,694), the central round rear scrap face, every overlapping resin ribbon and the raised shapes at top and right. Preserve all existing shapes and edges. Add nothing outside the silhouette. Nothing cropped, no new protrusions, no additional machinery or features. This is the BACK of the object, not the three-quarter reference view.

MATERIAL PAINT:
Apply the reference materials onto the existing shapes: black-violet Kreegan resin wraps with faint thin orange seams; bone-white ceramic and gold on the wrapped scrap; dark rubber on the existing visible hose surfaces; pale ivory on the bone claw clasp with its existing gold ring. Use the same design's colour family and restrained fine wear and chips. The central exposed round scrap rear surface is bone-white ceramic with its existing gold edging. Keep the wraps deep black-violet, not bright lavender. Orange seams and any existing orange sacs are painted at their glowing colour without bloom or illumination on neighbouring surfaces. Do not invent front-facing components that the guide does not expose.

LIGHTING / ALBEDO:
Even, flat, shadowless illumination from the viewer. The image is a texture source, not a beauty render. Paint surface colour only: no cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening in creases, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light, no gradients from directional lighting. Gold retains its warm gold material colour but has no baked glare. No background, no floor, no contact shadow, no text or watermark. Retain genuine zero-alpha transparency everywhere outside the guide's exact silhouette and in its openings.
Return only the completed painted guide, 1024 x 1024, unresized.
